description: This PHP class 'PimCsvDataImportService' provides functionality for importing CSV data related to HR information such as employee details in the OrangeHRM application. It defines header values, manages an internal CsvDataImportService instance, and exposes an import method to process CSV content.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImportService
classes.description: Service class for importing HR-related CSV data, specifically for the PIM module in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Returns the existing CsvDataImportService instance or creates a new one if it's null.

methods.name: setCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Sets the CsvDataImportService instance to be used by this service.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Imports CSV file content using the internal CsvDataImportService, specifying the import type and header fields.
